Lina: quick PSA: Mango (my sugar glider) discovered the jacket pocket nap and has now claimed it as a tiny airplane. posted evidence. :airplane: :honey_pot:
Omar: please tell me there's a picture. I need this for my personal archive. :pray:
Lina: uploaded an image: https://i.imgur.com/MangoPocket.jpg —look at that smug little pilot. he fell asleep mid-flight. :sleeping: :pilot:
Priya: omg the tuck and roll. that's a nap technique i aspire to. Mango is peak cozy-engineering. :sparkles:
Zane: is Mango accepting co-pilot applications? i'm experienced in snack distribution. :cookie:
Lina: applications accepted. requirements: treats, soft zipper, and a firm handshake (or gentle boop). :grin:
Omar: vote: should Mango be allowed to attend the next team offsite in a pocket? (yes / maybe if vaccinated / only if there are snacks)
ops-bot: Poll created: "Mango at offsite?" Options: Yes / Maybe (vaccinated) / Only with snacks. 7 votes so far.
Priya: also requesting pocket-cam footage. Mango in slo-mo glider mode would break the internet. :camera_with_flash:
Zane: reaction: :heart: this thread is an excellent use of company slack. thank you.
Lina: will compile a micro-gallery tonight. Mango sends a tiny paw wave and a sleepy squeak. <3
